description: Redeem the configured wallet's PT-USDG for USDG 1:1, from its maturity (2027-03-25) on, through Pendle's router: an approval of exactly that PT-USDG, then the redemption to this wallet. By default the PT of the oldest matured market the wallet holds (an earlier market's included); `market` names one (pt_position lists them). Before maturity it says to sell instead. State the amount to the user and get their go-ahead first; dry_run: true lists the calls without sending. Needs ETH for gas.

amount_pt.description: PT-USDG, e.g. 25.5, or "all" for the wallet's whole balance.

dry_run.description: true: only quote and list the calls, send nothing.

market.description: Optional: the market (or its PT) to redeem, as pt_position lists it. Default: the oldest matured market the wallet holds PT of.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage margin in basis points under the quote, 0 to 500. Default 100 (1%), 10 for a redemption.

name: pt_redeem
title: Redeem PT-USDG for USDG
